title: Anastasia's mate
line: Knight and rook against a king on the edge.

steps.text: Anastasia's mate: a knight deep in the camp takes two squares from the king, its own pawn takes a third, and a rook checks on the edge.
Tap the two squares beside the black king that the knight takes.
steps.hint: A knight jumps two squares one way and one square the other.
steps.after: The knight takes both, and the king's own pawn blocks the square between them.

steps.text: Mate with the rook on the edge of the board.
steps.hint: The rook slides along its row to the file the king stands on.
steps.after: Checkmate. The rook holds the whole edge, and the knight and pawn take the rest.

steps.text: Here a pawn stands in front of the king, so the edge is closed. The queen can open it by giving herself up.
Capture the pawn in front of the king with your queen, with check.
steps.hint: The queen goes straight down the edge of the board.
steps.after: The king has to take the queen, and now it stands on the open edge.

steps.hint: The same rook move as before.
steps.after: Anastasia's mate. The queen was a price worth paying.

summary: A knight that takes two squares beside the king, with a rook on the edge, mates. A queen given up can open the edge.
